repository_worktree_note: Milestone 6.1 changes were also present in the worktree; the voltage-divider fixture was unchanged. Per-scenario source and compiled artifact hashes are retained in each build manifest.

topola.docker_build_command: docker run --rm --mount type=bind,source=<repo>,target=/workspace --workdir /workspace/build/topola-source --env CARGO_HOME=/workspace/build/topola-cargo --env CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/workspace/build/topola-target --entrypoint /bin/sh rust@sha256:3914072ca0c3b8aad871db9169a651ccfce30cf58303e5d6f2db16d1d8a7e58f -c 'cargo build --locked --release -p topola-cli'
topola.seed: The CLI exposes no seed option. Repeating the base DSN produced a byte-identical SES.

measurement_notes.topola_runtime: Host wall time around the router Docker invocation; includes container startup and excludes DSN export, SES import, and DRC.
measurement_notes.tscircuit_runtime: Host wall time for the full pinned project build, including sandbox startup and PCB export; not an isolated autorouter time.
measurement_notes.track_length: Sum of copper track-segment lengths read back from pcbnew; vias are counted separately.
measurement_notes.routed_net_fraction: Expected named nets minus any net with at least one KiCad unconnected DRC group, divided by three.
